newsitem.title: UK: Russia's Novorossiisk oil port closed by weather.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Novorossiisk oil port closed by weather.

text.p: Russia's main Black Sea port of Novorossiisk has been closed since Sunday night due to bad weather, and six ships were waiting to load on Tuesday morning, shipping brokers and traders said.
Five crude tankers and one fuel oil tanker were at anchor and another six tankers were expected to arrive later in the day.
Bad weather and maintenance on the pipeline feeding the port has caused a backlog at Novorossiisk. Two of the tankers waiting at anchor were loading 135,000 tonnes and 146,000 tonnes of Urals crude.
No delays were reported at other Russian ports.

Mediterranean refiners said it was hard to assess the value of September Urals cargoes because of the loading delays and recent fluctuations in prompt deals. Last Friday, a cargo was sold for Dated Brent -75 cents but a distressed September loader changed hands on Monday at Dated Brent -90 cents.

The discount to Dated Brent has narrowed in recent weeks, because of the tightness of the sour grade in the Med largely as a result of the loading delays and the absence of large volumes of similar quality Iranian Heavy for September.

A Med trader said the sharp fall in outright values meant the margin for refiners of Urals had risen to $3 a barrel. He anticipated more demand for early October barrels, which he assessed would be done around the Dated -75/-80 cent range.
